blocks.text: After an easy first-round win, Alexandra Eala will face a fellow lefty, Diana Shnaider, in the round of 16 at the Ningbo Open on Wednesday, October 21. At stake is a place in the quarterfinals of the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) 500 event and a chance to face the winner between Iva Jovic and Jasmine Paolini. Both players stopped Eala at a Grand Slam earlier this year. Jovic stopped her in the third round of the U.S. Open last September 5, and Paolini beat her in a three-set battle in the fourth round of Wimbledon last July 6. READ ALSO: Alex […]...
